issues.title: Premature text truncation
issues.description: User role string truncates prematurely with an ellipsis despite available card width.
issues.suggestion: Increase max-width on the metadata line to allow full text display.
issues.triageNote: Truncation comes from the eval page's own content, not the component: pair-080/page.tsx:166 puts `truncate` (nowrap+ellipsis) on the single line '{handle} · {role}' inside a fixed w-72 card next to a 40px avatar — 288px card − 32px p-4 padding − 40px avatar − 12px gap ≈ 204px for text, while '@daeun · SRE · Incident Commander' at text-xs needs ~210px, so it clips mid-word ('Comma…'); HoverCardContent (hover-card.tsx) applies no truncate/overflow/max-width classes and the page already overrides the default w-64 with w-72 via twMerge, so there is nothing to fix in the component — the page file is off-limits to fix agents (page-level fix would be: drop `truncate` and let it wrap, split handle/role onto two lines, or widen the card to w-80).
